install_steps: sudo apt-get update && (sudo apt-get install -y openscap-scanner || sudo apt-get install -y openscap-utils)
note: Fedora/RHEL: sudo dnf install openscap-scanner. Benchmark content ships in the scap-security-guide package (apt install ssg-debian / dnf install scap-security-guide) — look under /usr/share/xml/scap/ssg/content/.
